TC-16/S17.title: Day boundaries, seeded: a new-day write that resends yesterday's lines lists none twice; a diverging resend and late-evening row dates are recorded
TC-16/S17.detail: New local spec (API writes the clients send, then the Encounter tab read on a correctly clocked browser; no model call, tripwire clean). (a) judged, 4/4: yesterday's M1, M2 are one 'Oct 13 (prior)' row, Most Recent holds only M3, no line twice, no three-line row. Recorded only: (a2) a resend that differs from yesterday's in one time string is stored as sent, so A and B are listed in both rows (A×2, B×2) — a human judges this against U11; (c) late-evening typed notes rotate into rows dated by the server's UTC day, not the physician's Eastern day: Hospital typed 20:30 ET Oct 12 → 'Oct 13 · Encounter notes'; Nursing Home typed 20:30 ET Oct 13 → 'Oct 14 · Visit notes' (Q9, D10).
